lines.t: Come walk with me in the garden once more I have poured out my love

Just to draw you near
Beloved, you have sought me

Yet the fullness of my love
You have yet to understand
And only taste it
Come, take your fill
If it's my love that you seek
Then come to me now
No more time to tarry
Open your heart, let me in
Come to me, come to me, come to me, beloved
Dee-da-dee-da-dee, come to me
If it's my love that you want

My arms open wide
Come to me, come to me
Come to me, beloved
Dee-da-dee-da-dee
